acceptance.given: A TC-D1 evaluation-seed artifact is presented to the repository Toolchain validator with its baseline-status and authorization fields available for validation.

oracle.expected: The validator accepts only the explicit non-authorizing-candidates baseline status together with authorizes: []; TC-D1 evaluation work therefore remains non-baseline.
forbidden: A quality baseline status or any authorization that accepts or publishes a quality baseline is accepted.
TC-D1 scope validation reports success for a quality-baseline proposal.
oracle.observable: The evaluation-artifact validation result contains the deterministic rejection that evaluation seeds must not publish a quality baseline.

acceptance.then: The scope validator rejects the proposal and emits no successful TC-D1 evaluation result.
acceptance.when: TC-D1 scope or implementation work is evaluated with a seed artifact that creates, accepts, or publishes a quality baseline.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate the evaluation-seed artifact from baseline_status: non-authorizing-candidates or authorizes: [] to a quality-baseline-publishing value; validation must reject the artifact.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the TC-D1 evaluation-artifact scope validation so that any artifact creating, accepting, or publishing a quality baseline is rejected, while valid non-authorizing candidate classification remains valid.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain the existing non-authorizing-candidates and authorizes: [] contract; rollback removes only the new rejection extension and never creates or accepts a quality baseline.

slice_hint.state_transition: A proposed TC-D1 artifact that creates or accepts a quality baseline transitions from pending scope evaluation to deterministic rejection; a conforming non-authorizing artifact proceeds without creating a quality baseline.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator returns failure for every quality-baseline-publishing proposal and returns no successful TC-D1 evaluation result from that proposal.

acceptance.given: Frozen historical tracked membership and the pre-repair byte identities are available as comparison inputs.

oracle.expected: The comparison reports that every protected existing byte is unchanged.
forbidden: Treating appended repair evidence as a rewrite of historical bytes.
oracle.observable: The historical-byte comparison result produced during the FR-5 preservation check.

acceptance.then: Existing bytes remain unchanged and any repair evidence is append-only.
acceptance.when: The historical preservation check compares the frozen baseline with the repair candidate.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise the historical-byte comparison with a changed protected byte and require the preservation check to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve and verify protected historical byte identities during repair without rewriting the frozen source set.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Historical tracked membership, repository-relative paths, and protected bytes remain compatible and unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen existing bytes -> byte-level preservation verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The preservation check establishes unchanged protected bytes; any protected-byte difference is rejected.

acceptance.given: The compiled Atomic Obligation graph contains command nodes and their claimed obligation coverage edges.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports a bidirectional mapping between every Atomic Obligation and its command coverage, with no orphan obligation or command node.
forbidden: A command node without reverse Atomic Obligation coverage.
An orphan command or Atomic Obligation in the command coverage relation.
oracle.observable: The exact-cover validator's structural coverage report produced while compiling or validating the obligation graph.

acceptance.then: Every Atomic Obligation and command coverage node is mutually and exactly covered.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain compiles the obligation graph or runs exact-cover validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Validate a graph containing an orphan or forward-only command-coverage edge and require the exact-cover validator to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate the Atomic Obligation-to-command relation as bidirectional Exact Cover, rejecting orphan command nodes and forward-only coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The existing Exact Cover graph representation remains the authority; the added check only rejects incomplete command coverage.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unverified command coverage edges -> structurally verified bidirectional Exact Cover relation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact-cover validation confirms reverse coverage for every Atomic Obligation-to-command edge and reports no orphan obligation or command node.

acceptance.given: The seed-manifest execution hint is compiled or emitted.

oracle.expected: The emitted hint contains exactly scripts/sc/tests/test_evaluation_seed_manifest.py in planned_new_files, execution_snapshot_paths, and allowed_write_paths, and does not treat that path as an existing test or execution evidence.
forbidden: Any changed, omitted, or substituted seed-manifest test path.
Present-test or execution-evidence claims for the planned path.
oracle.observable: The three emitted path arrays and their planned-path classification can be inspected.

acceptance.then: The hint preserves the unchanged planned path in all three required arrays and labels it only as planned.
acceptance.when: The compiled hint artifact is inspected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect the compiled seed-manifest execution hint and fail if any required path array omits, changes, or misclassifies scripts/sc/tests/test_evaluation_seed_manifest.py as existing evidence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve the exact planned seed-manifest test path in planned_new_files, execution_snapshot_paths, and allowed_write_paths without asserting that the planned file already exists or has executed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime state or schema change; revert only hint projection logic and its test authoring path.

slice_hint.state_transition: Hint emission transitions from unbound or misclassified path metadata to an explicit unchanged planned test path classification.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Compiled hint has exactly scripts/sc/tests/test_evaluation_seed_manifest.py in all three required arrays, with no existing-test or execution-evidence claim.
